comment: The MUTE, SOLO and pre-fader buttons are custom widgets rather than parameters, so they carry no line. The group strips and the crossfade of the larger mixers are absent here, and the four extra channel strips in the code are the aux returns. This mixer is built with nGROUPS set to 0, so the Pre-Mute menu item is compiled out and its right-click menu carries only Gain x1.5 and Do Not Mute when SOLOing.
